input: Take a CPR and first aid certification course

gold.taskTitle: Get CPR and First Aid Certified
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to complete a CPR and first aid certification course.

questions.title: Is this for a job, school, or personal readiness?
questions.description: Understand the primary reason the user wants this certification.

questions.title: Does a specific organization need to accept the cert?
questions.description: Determine if an employer, school, or body requires a cert from a specific provider such as the American Red Cross or American Heart Association.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person, online, or a blended format?
questions.description: Clarify the user's preferred learning and testing format for the course.

questions.title: What is your target completion date for this cert?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe the user is working toward.

questions.title: Which age groups do you need to be trained for?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs adult-only CPR or also infant and child CPR coverage.

questions.title: What city or zip code should we search courses in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to find nearby in-person course options.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this course?
questions.description: Understand any cost constraints that would influence which course or provider to choose.
